test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the campaign launched in January 2018 by the Union Minister for the environment, forest and climate change, which lauds small positive actions performed by individuals or organisations to strengthen the cause of environmental protection.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Green Good Deeds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Green Good Deeds** was launched in January **2018 **by the** Union Minister for the environment, forest and climate change,** which lauds small positive actions performed by individuals or organisations to strengthen the cause of environmental protection.
 
• **"Green Good Deeds" **is a concept for raising environmental awareness and getting people involved.
 
• The campaign, which was officially launched in January 2018, recognises tiny, good actions taken by individuals or organisations to advance the cause of environmental protection.
 
• To fulfil their Green Social Responsibility, the Ministry has compiled a list of over 600 Green Good Deeds and requested people to change their behaviour to Green Good Behaviour.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change's (MoEF&CC) Green Skill Development Programme (GSDP) **is a skill development initiative in the environment and forest sector designed to help India's young find gainful work and/or self-employment.
 
• On May 5, 2015, Blueair started the** Clean Air India Movement (CLAIM)** in India. Blueair, a premium air purifier brand, spearheaded the campaign, with Vijay Kannan, the company's India director, playing a crucial role.
 
• **Champions of the Earth** was developed by the United Nations Environment Programme in 2005 as an annual awards programme to honour outstanding environmental leaders from the public and corporate sectors, as well as from civil society.
